stem_book: A uniform wire is bent into the structure shown in the figure and placed on a table. It consists of two half rings of radius R and two straight parts of length πR; each half ring stands in a vertical plane with its diameter on the table, and both straight parts lie on the table. The height of the COM from the table is (a) 2R/π (b) R/π (c) R/2 (d) zero
work: h = (2·πRλ·(2R/π) + 2·πRλ·0)/(4πRλ) = 4R²/(4πR) = R/π (figure crude; orientation stated in stem)
